agent-questions: Styles and scans the native question card. It renders no surface of its own; the card it decorates belongs to DSH core and needs a live model turn to appear.
diff-viewed: Adds a Viewed toggle to the deliverables review pane. The pane only exists for a turn that produced reviewable files, and the scratch seeds create none.
goal-stall-guard: Host-side goal policy. It renders nothing itself: the pause, continue or close it decides appears in the native goal controls.
send-after-upload: Its banner exists only while an attachment upload is still finishing, which a local scratch upload never holds open long enough to capture.
shared-runtime: Loads the one shared copy of the Client UI modules. It renders no surface of its own to screenshot.
shortcuts: Installs keyboard chords only. Every visible result belongs to the surface whose control the chord drives, not to this plugin.
ui-styles: Compiles and injects the shared plugin stylesheet once per page. It has no screen of its own, only the sheets other plugins render with.
